svg.title: Requested outreach drafts with manual Gmail sending
svg.desc: Telegram messages enter a saved queue. LangGraph answers questions and uses reading tools. Only an explicit email request and the owner's Start outreach action enter drafting. The workflow researches, qualifies, resolves recipients, checks contacts, writes and reviews drafts. Requested Gmail drafts are saved once and announced. The owner reviews, edits and sends in Gmail, outside the agent. App-only drafts retain review controls. SQLite or one Supabase PostgreSQL database holds saved state.
